initial_prompt: Roadmap card P1. Seeded from .claude/plans/persona-design/BRIEF.md (§1–§2 measurement at d026bb7f7; §3–§7 superseded) and RULINGS.md (owner rulings 2026-10-17). Retire the word 'persona': an access level of the deployment's own agent is a TIER (readonly/readwrite/admin; tiers/ folder, top-level, named by users[].tier, default_tier, authorization.roles.<r>.tier and dispatch.tier); another agent a deployment offers is an APP (apps/ folder; logbook, knowledge, channel-finder), attached only, opened from a shared card listed in modules.web_terminals.shared. One definition per app: lists and brief from the app preset, config from the host, no exclude list on any card. Standalone app deployments (ariel-standalone, channel-finder-standalone) are deleted with their bundles, fixtures and docs. Old keys load for one minor release with a deprecation line. The profile card lists the conditional MCP servers (graph, event_dispatcher). Agent-tree R5'/R12' are recorded for card AT, not built here.

followup_responses.question: Shared app card port slot
followup_responses.answer: Count down from INDEX_MAX (99) in `shared:` list order; people count up from 0. Removing a shared app may shift later shared slots (harmless: no per-person state, URL is /u/<name>/). Lint includes derived slots in collision and family-allocatable checks.

followup_responses.question: dispatch.tier scope
followup_responses.answer: In P1 as its own, last phase: the dispatcher's workers run the named tier's render (image <project>-<tier>:local, CONFIG_FILE and paths under /app/<project>-<tier>, the tier's flattened config staged for the worker, image built before the worker starts). Unset keeps today's behaviour. Bridges need no key: they go through the dispatcher.

patterns: Location is the type: a file is a persona delta only because its parent dir is personas/ beside profile.yml (profile_root.py:59-73). Content never decides the kind.

Three listings of personas/ must stay in lockstep: build loop (build_cmd.py:2573), hash fold (build_profile_merge.py:1030-1040), staleness fingerprint (staleness.py:421-431); otherwise an edit ships silently or refuses forever.
One merge semantic today: _deep_merge unions string lists; an app merge (lists from the app preset, config from the host) needs its own composer beside merge_persona_delta.

The roster NAME is the identity for everything (container, compose service, /u/<name>/, env suffix, volumes); index only drives ports (port = family base + index, INDEX_MAX 99). freeze_user_indices exists so removing a person never shifts another's ports.
Optional roster fields are added only when set, so old configs render byte-identically.
The landing card label is the roster name; display_name only becomes OSPREY_WEB_APP_NAME (tab title); the sidecar chooser also shows the roster name.

The render is chosen by image + CONFIG_FILE; agent cwd = parent of CONFIG_FILE; worker image <project>:local is reserved by lint (persona_project_shadows_worker_image). Persona images are <project>-<persona>:local.
Bridges never run the agent: they POST to the dispatcher and poll one worker URL. The dispatcher has one dispatch_target for all triggers.
Pin tables keyed on list_presets() (hash, hook, dependency, facility, web_panels) must equal the shipped set: deleting a preset = deleting its rows.

The config-key guard's union covers ROOT presets + framework template only; keys only the standalones spell become phantom when they go; same-value marks need two stating presets; governed_sets.claims empties silently.
Explicit-config fixtures are frozen at baseline sha 246198f1c: edit cells.json/meta.json by hand, do not re-freeze.
Strict vs lenient resolution: binding surfaces raise, reporting surfaces (lint, card, summary) degrade with strict=False.
